name: Number of attendees
descriptionShort: Number of people attending major AI research conferences, including in-person, online, and hybrid participants.
descriptionKey:
- Covers a set of major AI conferences tracked by the AI Index, including large events such as NeurIPS, ICML, and CVPR.
- Conferences are an important way researchers share new work and engage with the wider AI community.
- Attendance includes people joining in person, online, or in hybrid formats.
- Many conferences have moved online or to hybrid formats in recent years, which can increase participation and make comparisons over time less straightforward.
- Figures are based on data reported by conference organizers or published online.

origins.title: AI Index Report
origins.description: The AI Index Report tracks, collates, distills, and visualizes data related to artificial intelligence (AI). The mission is to provide unbiased, rigorously vetted, broadly sourced data to enable policymakers, researchers, executives, journalists, and the general public to develop a more thorough and nuanced understanding of the complex field of AI.
